title: Indian Malt Whisky Association signs pact with Scotch Whisky Association
description:
The Indian Malt Whisky Association (IMWA) and the Scotch Whisky Association (SWA) have signed a cooperation agreement, which will focus on sustainability, protection and promotion of their respective products, and engagement on regulatory matters of mutual interest.
As per a joint statement, the pact also provides for cooperation on legal protection, product authenticity, intellectual property infringements, and the promotion of responsible consumption.
The India-UK Free Trade Agreement (FTA), which came into effect on July 15, 2026, is expected to boost Scotch whisky sales in India by reducing import duties from 150 per cent to 75 per cent, with a phased reduction to 40 per cent over the next decade.
The trade pact could also open up opportunities for Indian single malt whiskies to gain a foothold in the UK market, with some brands having already received international recognition for their quality and craftsmanship.
